opening.argument: The central fact is that this is CBC news coverage warning viewers about callers falsely claiming to be from Microsoft. It recounts a caller who allegedly sought access to a person's computer by claiming it was corrupted and offering to fix it. The report also describes possible payment for computer cleaning and a threat attributed to the caller. A CBC Go Public page and an interview identifying a Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre representative reinforce the reporting context. These requests are presented as conduct being reported and warned about, not as an offer from the video creator or a solicitation to viewers.

citations.quote: On the line, a man claiming to be from Microsoft.
He wanted to get onto my computer to show me how badly corrupted it was and that he would fix it from there.
Those who fall for it are conned into paying a fee for having their computer cleaned
